mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, which compresses discount rates on equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 rises but 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals tightening monetary policy, increasing discount rates on equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% but 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movement in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and downward movement in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, amplifying equity valuation growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 up and FEDFUNDS down occur, yet 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate during a late-cycle expansion regime signals further accommodative policy, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines in late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines in late-cycle expansion but 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in job openings (PAYEMS) exceeding 132,000 signals robust labor market strength, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses above 132,000 but 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) and concurrent growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicate expanding supply and demand, reducing market tightness and fostering equity valuation appreciation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both INDPRO up and GDPC1 up occur, yet 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high unemployment rates (UNRATE) above 9.5% in a post-shock recovery regime signal weak labor market conditions, eroding investor confidence and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE remains above 9.5% in post-shock recovery regime
failure_condition: UNRATE stays above 9.5% in post-shock recovery but 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 600 units signals weakening demand in the housing sector, reducing corporate earnings and equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 600 but 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
